description: A Benjaminite town whose men's horrific crime against a Levite's concubine triggered a civil war that nearly wiped out the tribe of Benjamin (Judges 19-20). It later became the hometown and capital of Israel's first king, Saul, whose family — including Jonathan and Michal — is repeatedly identified with the place (1 Samuel 10:26; 11:4).
family_friendly_summary: Gibeah was a town in the land of Benjamin. A terrible crime by the men of the town led to a war that almost wiped out the whole tribe of Benjamin. Later, Gibeah became the hometown and capital of Saul, Israel's first king.
